title: Hidden Patterns

beats.narrativeText: With enough expedition data finally recovered, Atlas hands the learner something new: not a single mystery to solve, but months of measurements to make sense of.
On their own, the records look almost ordinary — weather, water, power, geology, each filed separately. But something about seeing them side by side feels like it shouldn't be a coincidence.
The learner compares datasets pulled from across the expedition's records, mission by mission.
Turning the combined data into graphs does something no single dataset could: it reveals a pattern that had been hiding in plain sight the whole time.
The learner must name the trend precisely and explain their conclusion using the evidence itself, not just a hunch that something connects.
The hidden pattern doesn't belong to just one mission — it threads through several of them at once, tying investigations that once felt separate into a single story.
The learner reflects on how investigations that once seemed completely unrelated turn out to be pieces of the same picture.
The learner's confidence in interpreting complex information grows — and so does the sense that Outpost Echo's mystery is far bigger than any single mission has shown so far.

activities.title: Compare Datasets
activities.storyContext: Atlas hands over measurements collected over many months — more data than any single mission has asked the learner to work with before.
activities.instructions: Compare a few datasets collected at different points during the expedition, noting anything that looks similar between them.

activities.title: Create Graphs
activities.storyContext: Individually, the records seem ordinary — combined, they might reveal something none of them showed on their own.
activities.instructions: Create graphs combining the datasets so that any pattern becomes something you can actually see, not just sense.

activities.title: Identify Trends
activities.storyContext: A repeating pattern has been sitting in the data all along — nobody combined the records carefully enough to notice it until now.
activities.instructions: Identify any trend that appears across the combined graphs, and be precise about exactly what it is.
activities.output: A description of the identified trend.

activities.title: Explain Conclusions Using Evidence
activities.storyContext: A good conclusion is always supported by evidence — a pattern that looks convincing on a graph still needs the data behind it spelled out.
activities.instructions: Explain what the trend means, using specific evidence from the datasets to support your conclusion.
activities.output: A written conclusion supported by evidence.

activities.title: Predict Future Observations
activities.storyContext: If the trend continues, future observations should follow the same pattern.
activities.instructions: Use the identified trend to predict what future observations might show.
activities.output: A prediction supported by the identified trend.

activities.title: Discovering Hidden Patterns in Data
activities.storyContext: Finding hidden patterns in large amounts of data is a real scientific skill.
activities.instructions: Find out how scientists discover hidden patterns within large datasets.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: Which earlier missions do you think are connected by this pattern, and what makes you confident they're actually related rather than just coincidence?

discussionPoints: What pattern did you notice once the datasets were combined?
Which earlier missions do you think are connected, and why?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a clearly explained trend supported by evidence drawn from multiple datasets.

completionCriteria: Datasets compared, graphs created, and trends explained using evidence.
